context: Minsc has returned to the Guildhall after discovering a Zhentarim plot to overthrow Nine‑Fingers; the Zhentarim stand arrayed under their leader (credited in files as Roah or Boss Friol) while the Guild and your party hold the hall. Friol taunts Minsc with his former identity as the "Stone Lord," accusing him of killings done in the name of the Absolute; the charge visibly upsets him as he insists he is no longer that person. Friol frames the coup as pragmatic—claiming a Zhentarim‑run Guild could beat the Absolute and "do what's necessary"—and offers the player a choice to accept her plan or oppose it. The player must therefore decide whether to back Minsc (and fight Friol/Roah and the Zhentarim) or allow the Zhentarim takeover for the purported greater good; Jaheira may appear in some variations.
